properties.name: stand.test.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the stand-test auto-configuration. When false, no SDK beans are contributed.

properties.name: stand.test.version
properties.description: Declared FORMAT version of the environment registry (not the SDK version). Absent means 1; a version newer than this SDK reads is rejected with a message naming both versions. Sections introduced later (ui-applications: version 2) require the version to be declared.

properties.name: stand.test.await.timeout
properties.description: Default total wait for the reusable AwaitPolicy bean.

properties.name: stand.test.await.poll-interval
properties.description: Default poll interval for the reusable AwaitPolicy bean.

properties.name: stand.test.reporting.enabled
properties.description: Global reporting switch. When false, no reporting publisher is contributed (the no-op fallback is used), regardless of stand.test.reporting.allure.enabled.

properties.name: stand.test.reporting.allure.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Allure reporting publisher is preferred when stand-test-allure is on the classpath. Falls back to the no-op publisher when false.
